text_block_list.text:
The trio consisting of Бива Хаяхидэ,
Narita
Taishin, and Уиннинг Тикит has
been dubbed
"BNW" and is garnering
attention.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Today, they compete in the Satsuki Sho,
the first
race of the Classic Triple Crown
tour.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Each of them has their own strong
motivation to
win, so this is bound to be
an exciting race!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
